steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Moc Duong, a wood element leaf mantis, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: eyes locked on the food on the floor, antennae twitching; (3) EAT: snatching it with a lightning fast strike of its forearms; (4) EAT: holding the bite up to its mouth, nibbling very fast. Row 2: (5) EAT: cleaning its forearms and antennae, satisfied; (6) PLAY: swaying side to side in a kung fu stance; (7) PLAY: leaping forward, leaf wings buzzing open; (8) PLAY: hovering mid-air with blurred wings. Row 3: (9) PLAY: spinning roundhouse kick in the air; (10) PLAY: landing in a ninja pose; (11) PLAY: both forearms raised in victory; (12) REFUSE food: crossing its forearms in an X. Row 4: (13) PETTED: antennae curling happily, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving one forearm; (15) SAD: hunched over, antennae drooping; (16) ANGRY: wings flared, forearms raised menacingly.
